title: Total Quality Management in IT: Main Exam, 24 August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Quality management is an important concept in strategic planning and a component of strategy. Explain.
Examine the dimensions of service quality.
Process improvement is one of the key principles that influence the success of TQM programmes. Extrapolate.
Evaluate various techniques that organizations can apply to identify customer expectations.
Discuss how poor service can affect organizational performance.
Critically examine why TQM has been considered as burdensome to organizations by some professionals.
Examine the limitations associated with benchmarking.
Analyse the main steps in the functioning of control charts as an instrument for quality management in the organization.
Discuss the fundamental principles of business process re-engineering (BPR).
Analyse the concept of process management in the context of Six Sigma programme implementation.
Discuss the key stages in supplier development.
Examine the drivers of business process re-engineering (BPR) in business organizations.
